pairs.target: sè lā zuòzài xuégōng ménwài de chángdèng shàng , zhèngzài bǎ xiélǐ de xiǎoshízǐ dǎo chūlái .
pairs.english: Sela sat on the bench outside the academy gate, shaking a little stone from her shoe.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉坐在学宫门外的长凳上，正在把鞋里的小石子倒出来。

alignment.english: shaking a little stone from her shoe

pairs.target: tǎ wéi pǎo dào tā miànqián shí , tā táishǒu jiào tā bié cǎi .
pairs.english: When Tavi ran up, she raised a hand to stop him stepping on it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跑到她面前时，她抬手叫他别踩。

pairs.target: shízǐ luò zài xié jiān xià , tā shēn zhǐ jiǎnqǐlái , wǎng lùbiān yì tán , cái bǎ jiǎo chóngxīn shēnjìnqù .
pairs.english: The stone landed beneath the toe of her shoe. She picked it up and flicked it to the roadside before putting her foot back in.
pairs.hanzi: 石子落在鞋尖下，她伸指捡起来，往路边一弹，才把脚重新伸进去。

pairs.target: bó yà zuòzài lìngyìtóu , xī shàng fàng zhe yìbāo bǐng ,
pairs.english: Boya sat at the other end with a packet of bread on her knees.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅坐在另一头，膝上放着一包饼，

pairs.target: kànzhe tā xiào , shuō rén yǐjīng dào le , búbì bǎ shèngxià bàntiáo lù yě pǎo wán .
pairs.english: She smiled at him and said they had arrived; he need not run the remaining half of the road too.
pairs.hanzi: 看着他笑，说人已经到了，不必把剩下半条路也跑完。

pairs.target: zhè shì xìn lǐ yuē hǎo de rìzi .
pairs.english: This was the day arranged by letter.
pairs.hanzi: 这是信里约好的日子。

pairs.target: xī jiē chàng wán gē de nàwǎn , tǎ wéi gěi jiālǐ xiě le xìn , bǎ gōngfáng chūshì , huànwū shàngkè hé zìjǐ chóngxīn liànxí de shì dōu xiě le .
pairs.english: On the evening after the West Steps singing, Tavi had written home about the workshop incident, the classroom move, and starting practice again.
pairs.hanzi: 西阶唱完歌的那晚，塔维给家里写了信，把工房出事、换屋上课和自己重新练习的事都写了。

pairs.target: tā xiān xiě méi rén shòushāng , yòu bǎ zhè jù huà nuó dào zuìhòu , juéde fàngzài qiánmiàn tài xiàng hòutou yào yǒu huàixiāoxī .
pairs.english: He first wrote that nobody had been hurt, then moved that sentence to the end, feeling that starting with it made bad news seem about to follow.
pairs.hanzi: 他先写没人受伤，又把这句话挪到最后，觉得放在前面太像后头要有坏消息。

pairs.target: bó yà de huíxìn hěn duǎn , shuō xiūgōng nàtiān liǎng rén yìqǐ shànglái , yǒu huà dāngmiàn jiǎng .
pairs.english: Boya's short reply said they would come up together on their day off and talk in person.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅的回信很短，说休工那天两人一起上来，有话当面讲。

pairs.target: rújīn rén zhēn zuòzài zhèlǐ , tā fǎnér bù zhīdào xiān jiǎng shénme , zhī wèn shàngpō lèibulèi .
pairs.english: Now that they were really here, he did not know what to say first and only asked whether the climb had tired them.
pairs.hanzi: 如今人真坐在这里，他反而不知道先讲什么，只问上坡累不累。

alignment.english: whether the climb had tired them

pairs.target: " chē dào xièhuò kǒu , hòumiàn zhè duàn háihǎo . " sè lā shuō , " nǐ xiān bié dīng zhe wǒ de jiǎo . "
pairs.english: “The cart came to the unloading point; this last stretch was fine,” Sela said. “Stop staring at my feet.”
pairs.hanzi: “车到卸货口，后面这段还好。”瑟拉说，“你先别盯着我的脚。”

pairs.target: tā dài tāmen cóng huǎnpō rào jìn yuànzi , méiyǒu zǒu píngshí sānbù bìng liǎngbù de shíjiē .
pairs.english: He led them into the courtyard by the gentle slope instead of the steps he usually bounded up.
pairs.hanzi: 他带她们从缓坡绕进院子，没有走平时三步并两步的石阶。

pairs.target: sè lā zài shuǐtǒng páng tíngxiàlái , wèn zhème duō rén xǐshǒu , shuǐ shì shuí tiāo .
pairs.english: Sela stopped beside the water bucket and asked who carried enough water for so many people to wash their hands.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉在水桶旁停下来，问这么多人洗手，水是谁挑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō yǒurén lúnzhí , yě yǒu sòng shuǐ de gōngrén .
pairs.english: Tavi said there were rotations and workers who delivered water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说有人轮值，也有送水的工人。

pairs.target: bó yà suíkǒu suànle yíxià jǐtǒng gòuyòng , sè lā shuō tā lián xiē yìtiān dōu yào tì biérén suànzhàng .
pairs.english: Boya casually calculated how many buckets would be enough. Sela said she could not take one day off from doing other people's sums.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅随口算了一下几桶够用，瑟拉说她连歇一天都要替别人算账。

pairs.target: mǐlā cóng cè wū chūlái , shǒushàng zhān zhe mùxiè .
pairs.english: Mira came out of the side room with wood dust on her hands.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉从侧屋出来，手上沾着木屑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gāng jièshào dào yíbàn , sè lā jiù shuō zhīdào , xìn lǐ nàge zuò xiǎoqiáo de .
pairs.english: Tavi was halfway through introducing her when Sela said she knew: the girl who made the little bridge in his letters.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维刚介绍到一半，瑟拉就说知道，信里那个做小桥的。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào le , méi wèn xìn lǐ zěnme xiě zìjǐ , xiān bǎmén tuīkāi , ràng tā kàn kàochuāng de móxíng .
pairs.english: Mira smiled without asking what he had written about her, opened the door, and showed her the model by the window.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉笑了，没问信里怎么写自己，先把门推开，让她看靠窗的模型。

pairs.target: sè lā mōmō hóngbùtiáo , wèn shìbushì zhèlǐ lā .
pairs.english: Sela touched the red cloth and asked whether this was where to pull.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉摸摸红布条，问是不是这里拉。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō shì , děng tā zuò wěn cái dìguòlái .
pairs.english: Mira said yes and waited until she was comfortably seated before handing it over.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说是，等她坐稳才递过来。

pairs.target: mù liáng yí kāishí , sè lā dītóu kàn xiàmiàn de huázuò , rènzhēn dé xiàng zài tiāo yìpī néng bunéng mài de qián huò .
pairs.english: As the wooden beam moved, Sela bent to examine the carriage beneath, as intent as if assessing a batch of saleable salvage.
pairs.hanzi: 木梁移开时，瑟拉低头看下面的滑座，认真得像在挑一批能不能卖的钱货。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhè bǐ tǎ wéi yǐqián ná huíjiā de tiěpiàn dàduō le ,
pairs.english: She said it was much bigger than the iron scraps Tavi used to bring home.
pairs.hanzi: 她说这比塔维以前拿回家的铁片大多了，

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn shuō búshì zìjǐ zuò de , sè lā kàn le tā yìyǎn , shuō tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Tavi hurried to say he had not made it. Sela glanced at him and said she had heard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧说不是自己做的，瑟拉看了他一眼，说听见了。

pairs.target: tā ěrduo yǒudiǎn rè . bó yà yǐjīng zài kàn shuōmíng shàng de míngzì ,
pairs.english: His ears grew warm. Boya was already reading the names on the explanation.
pairs.hanzi: 他耳朵有点热。博娅已经在看说明上的名字，

pairs.target: niàn dào jièyòng nà yíduàn , méiyǒu wǎng xià zhuīwèn , zhī shuō zì gòu dà , kàndéqīng .
pairs.english: Reaching the passage about borrowing, she asked no further questions, only said the writing was large and clear.
pairs.hanzi: 念到借用那一段，没有往下追问，只说字够大，看得清。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jìnlái qǔ túcè , tǎ wéi jièshào wán , sè lā biàn wèn néng bunéng dānwù yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey came in for an atlas. After Tavi introduced them, Sela asked to take a little of her time.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师进来取图册，塔维介绍完，瑟拉便问能不能耽误一会儿。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu kàn érzi , hǎoxiàng pà kàn le jiù huì bèi tā xiān jiěshì wán .
pairs.english: She did not look at her son, as though fearing he would explain everything first if she did.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有看儿子，好像怕看了就会被他先解释完。

pairs.target: tā wèn nàxiē zìjǐ dòng qǐlái de dōngxī hái zài bu zài , yòu wèn huàn le wū shìbushì jiù búhuì zài fāshēng .
pairs.english: She asked whether the things that had moved by themselves were still there and whether changing rooms meant it could not happen again.
pairs.hanzi: 她问那些自己动起来的东西还在不在，又问换了屋是不是就不会再发生。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ túcè fàngxià , xiān lā le bǎ yǐzi , shuō liángjù hái liú zhe jiǎnchá , běi yì méi kāifàng .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey put down the atlas and pulled up a chair, saying the instruments were still being checked and the north wing remained closed.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把图册放下，先拉了把椅子，说量具还留着检查，北翼没开放。

pairs.target: dōng wū lìng yǒu jīchǔ , yǐjīng jiǎnchá guò , yě zài guānchá , dàn tā bùnéng shuō yíjù yǐhòu shénme dōu búhuì yǒu .
pairs.english: The east room had a separate foundation, had been inspected, and was under observation, but she could not promise nothing would ever happen.
pairs.hanzi: 东屋另有基础，已经检查过，也在观察，但她不能说一句以后什么都不会有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bùyóudé kàn xiàng sè lā . tā de zuǐjiǎo shōujǐn yìdiǎn , què méiyǒu mǎshàng jiào tā huíjiā .
pairs.english: Tavi could not help looking toward Sela. Her mouth tightened a little, but she did not immediately tell him to come home.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维不由得看向瑟拉。她的嘴角收紧一点，却没有马上叫他回家。

pairs.target: tā wèn zàiyǒu shì , shuí huì gàosù jiālǐ .
pairs.english: She asked who would tell the family if something else happened.
pairs.hanzi: 她问再有事，谁会告诉家里。

pairs.target: wūlǐ jìng le piànkè .
pairs.english: The room fell quiet for a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里静了片刻。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī shuō , zhèhuí méiyǒu shāngzhě , xuéxiào xiān tōngzhī liǎo dāngwǎn láifǎng de rén , duì jiālǐ zhī ràng xuéshēng zìjǐ xiě ,
pairs.english: Instructor Vey said that with no injuries this time, the school had first notified that evening's visitors and left students to write home.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师说，这回没有伤者，学校先通知了当晚来访的人，对家里只让学生自己写，

pairs.target: quèshí yǒurén huì hěn wǎn cái zhīdào .
pairs.english: Some families would indeed have learned very late.
pairs.hanzi: 确实有人会很晚才知道。

pairs.target: tā nálái dēngjìcè , qǐng bó yà liúxià chángyòng de shōuxìn dìdiǎn , shuō huì bǎ jiāshǔ tōngzhī zhèjiàn shì jiāogěi fùzé de rén bǔ shàng .
pairs.english: She fetched a register and asked Boya to leave their usual postal address, saying she would ask those responsible to improve family notifications.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿来登记册，请博娅留下常用的收信地点，说会把家属通知这件事交给负责的人补上。

pairs.target: sè lā wèn néng bunéng yě liú bó yà de míngzì , lǎoshī shuō néng .
pairs.english: Sela asked whether Boya's name could be included too. The instructor said yes.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉问能不能也留博娅的名字，老师说能。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài zhuōbiān , hūrán hěn xiǎng bǎ jiālǐ nàtiáo lù huà dé zhěngqí yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: Standing beside the table, Tavi suddenly wanted to draw the road home more neatly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在桌边，忽然很想把家里那条路画得整齐一点。

pairs.target: bó yà yǐjīng yòngbǐ xiěxià záhuòpù hé zìjǐ de zhíbān dìdiǎn , zì bǐ tā de xiǎo , què yìdiǎn yě bù jǐ .
pairs.english: Boya had already written the grocery and her duty station, in writing smaller than his but not crowded at all.
pairs.hanzi: 博娅已经用笔写下杂货铺和自己的值班地点，字比他的小，却一点也不挤。

pairs.target: lǎoshī zǒu hòu , tā dīshēng wèn sè lā shìbushì juéde bùgāi lái dúshū .
pairs.english: After the instructor left, he quietly asked whether Sela thought he should not have come to study.
pairs.hanzi: 老师走后，他低声问瑟拉是不是觉得不该来读书。

pairs.target: " wǒ shì zài wèn , chū liǎo shì zěnme zhīdào . " tā shuō , " búshì lái tì nǐ bǎ shū shōuzǒu . "
pairs.english: “I'm asking how I'll know if something happens,” she said. “I haven't come to pack up your books.”
pairs.hanzi: “我是在问，出了事怎么知道。”她说，“不是来替你把书收走。”

pairs.target: tā bǎshǒu gē zài xī shàng , róu le yíxià , yòu shuō bú fàngxīn dāngrán shì bú fàngxīn .
pairs.english: She rested a hand on her knee, rubbed it, and said of course she worried.
pairs.hanzi: 她把手搁在膝上，揉了一下，又说不放心当然是不放心。

pairs.target: yǐqián tā qù lúbiān , tā yě bú fàngxīn , méi shuō jiù bù děngyú xīnlǐ méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She had worried when he worked by the furnaces too; not saying so did not mean she never felt it.
pairs.hanzi: 以前他去炉边，她也不放心，没说就不等于心里没有。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ xìn lǐ nà jù nuó lái nuó qù dehuà , méi zài bǎozhèng xiàcì yídìng shénme dōu hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the sentence he had moved around in his letter and did not promise everything would be fine next time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起自己信里那句挪来挪去的话，没再保证下次一定什么都好。

pairs.target: wǔfàn shí , yīwén tì tāmen duān lái liǎngwǎn tāng , bào le zìjǐ de míngzì .
pairs.english: At lunch Iven brought them two bowls of soup and introduced himself.
pairs.hanzi: 午饭时，伊文替她们端来两碗汤，报了自己的名字。

pairs.target: sè lā xiān xièxiè tā , yòu wèn shìbushì nàge tíxǐng tǎ wéi shài wàzi de péngyǒu .
pairs.english: Sela thanked him, then asked if he was the friend who reminded Tavi to dry his socks.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉先谢谢他，又问是不是那个提醒塔维晒袜子的朋友。

pairs.target: yīwén lèng le yíxià , shuō nà dàgài shì pà wò .
pairs.english: Iven paused, then said that was probably Pavo.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文愣了一下，说那大概是帕沃。

pairs.target: zhènghǎo pà wò lùguò , tīngjiàn wàzi liǎnggè zì jiù tíngxià , shuō zìjǐ de míngshēng zěnme yǐjīng zhuàndào shānxià le .
pairs.english: Pavo happened to pass, stopped at the word “socks,” and wondered how his reputation had already traveled downhill.
pairs.hanzi: 正好帕沃路过，听见袜子两个字就停下，说自己的名声怎么已经传到山下了。

pairs.target: yìzhuō rén xiào qǐlái .
pairs.english: Everyone at the table laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 一桌人笑起来。

pairs.target: sè lā chī wán yíkuài bǐng , bǎ shèngxià de tuī gěi bó yà , zìjǐ hái xiǎng zài zuò yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Sela finished a piece of bread, pushed the rest to Boya, and wanted to sit a while longer.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉吃完一块饼，把剩下的推给博娅，自己还想再坐一会儿。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuánxiān pà tā lèi , lián huíchéng chē dōu tì tā xiǎng hǎo le ,
pairs.english: Tavi had worried she would tire and had even planned her return cart.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原先怕她累，连回程车都替她想好了，

pairs.target: zhèshí cái fāxiàn tā zhèngzài tīng mǐlā shuō fùqīn xiūlù de shì , bìng méiyǒu děng tā fāhuà jiù zǒu .
pairs.english: Only now did he notice she was listening to Mira talk about her father's road work, not waiting for his word to leave.
pairs.hanzi: 这时才发现她正在听米拉说父亲修路的事，并没有等他发话就走。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ sòngdào xièhuò kǒu , tā bǎ yīdài lǐ yìxiǎo tuán xiàn gěi tā , shuō tā shàngcì fèng xiùkǒu yòng de kuàiméile .
pairs.english: That afternoon, at the unloading point, she gave him a small ball of thread from her pocket, saying the thread he had used on his cuff last time was nearly gone.
pairs.hanzi: 下午送到卸货口，她把衣袋里一小团线给他，说他上次缝袖口用的快没了。

pairs.target: chē lái yǐqián , tā yòu wèn xuégōng jiēxiàlái xué shénme .
pairs.english: Before the cart came, she asked what he would learn next at the academy.
pairs.hanzi: 车来以前，她又问学宫接下来学什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō guòxiētiān yào jiǎnchá jīchǔkè , zài ānpái lǎoshī dài zhe dào chéngwài jìnchù zuò cèliáng , hái méi dìng zìjǐ fēn nǎ zǔ .
pairs.english: Tavi said there would be a foundation-course check soon, followed by teacher-led measurement work near the city; his group was not yet assigned.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说过些天要检查基础课，再安排老师带着到城外近处做测量，还没定自己分哪组。

pairs.target: sè lā shuō nà xìn lǐ jìde xiě lùshang de shì , bié měicì zhī xiě chī dé hǎo .
pairs.english: Sela said to write about the road, not only that he was eating well each time.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉说那信里记得写路上的事，别每次只写吃得好。

pairs.target: chē guǎiguòqù yǐhòu , tǎ wéi mōlemō nà tuán xiàn , mànmàn zǒu huíqù .
pairs.english: After the cart turned away, Tavi touched the thread and slowly walked back.
pairs.hanzi: 车拐过去以后，塔维摸了摸那团线，慢慢走回去。

pairs.target: nà zhāng shài zhe tàiyáng de chángdèng yǐjīng zuò le biéde rén , jiǎo biān yě yǒu yìshuāng zhānní de xié .
pairs.english: Someone else now sat on the sunny bench, with another pair of muddy shoes at their feet.
pairs.hanzi: 那张晒着太阳的长凳已经坐了别的人，脚边也有一双沾泥的鞋。
